pieces.Text: You select one spell from the wizard spell list that is of a magus spell level you can cast. You add this spell to your spellbook and list of magus spells known as a magus spell of its wizard spell level. You can instead select two spells to add in this way, but both must be at least one level lower than the highest-level magus spell you can cast. You can select this magus arcana more than once.
